critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token onto every request — testing agents writing new tests must explicitly set X-Admin-Token: '' to test non-admin/anon flows or they'll get false PASS/FAIL. Documented in test_iter_D_final_qa.py.

Operations Center audit_coverage.value is a structured dict {coverage_pct, covered, total, modules[]} — not a flat number. Frontend OperationsCenter.jsx must handle both shapes (numeric or dict.coverage_pct).

PO Requests CSV export route is /api/po-requests/export.csv (declared before /{po_id} dynamic route to avoid resolver conflict). Iter D request listed /export/csv which 404s — minor doc inconsistency.

All 7 portal login endpoints use distinct token headers (X-Admin/HR/PM/Safety/Shop/Dispatch-Token + X-Leadership-Token). Conftest auto-inject of X-Admin-Token means admin auth dominates if multiple tokens are sent — explicit empty override is required for non-admin tests.
Operations Center role_override is correctly admin-gated server-side; HR sending role_override=admin returns HR-scoped cards (no equipment_down leak).
